text: This is the story. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the great war. <break time="0.8s" /> That Rikki tikki tavi fought all by himself. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a mongoose. <break time="0.8s" /> A small animal. <break time="0.8s" /> That looked a little like a cat. <break time="0.8s" /> One summer. <break time="0.8s" /> A big flood washed him. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the hole. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he lived with his family. <break time="0.8s" /> He held on to a piece of floating grass. <break time="0.8s" /> Until he lost his senses. <break time="0.8s" /> When he woke up. <break time="0.8s" /> He was lying. <break time="0.8s" /> On a garden path. <break time="0.8s" /> In the hot sun. <break time="0.8s" /> A small boy named Teddy. <break time="0.8s" /> Found him and said. <break time="0.8s" /> Here is a dead mongoose. <break time="0.8s" /> Let us have a funeral. <break time="0.8s" /> No, said his mother. <break time="0.8s" /> Let us take him in and dry him. <break time="0.8s" /> They wrapped him. <break time="0.8s" /> In warm cotton. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon he opened his eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> And sneezed. <break time="0.8s" /> Every mongoose family has a motto. <break time="0.8s" /> Which is Run and find out. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki ran all around the table. <break time="0.8s" /> And jumped up. <break time="0.8s" /> Onto Teddys shoulder. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not be afraid, Teddy. <break time="0.8s" /> Said his father. <break time="0.8s" /> That is how. <break time="0.8s" /> He makes friends. <break time="0.8s" /> That night. <break time="0.8s" /> He slept on Teddys pillow. <break time="0.8s" /> Close to the boy.
